checks.selection_correctness: RISCVISelLowering.cpp:735-737: POST_INC f32 load is Legal only inside hasPULPExtV2() && hasStdExtZfinx(). No f32 indexed store action, so DAGCombiner (isIndexedStoreLegal) never forms f32 p.sw. getIndexedAddressPartsPulp accepts f32 only with Zfinx. RISCVISelDAGToDAG.cpp tryPulpIndexedLoad: the f32 case refuses anything except NON_EXTLOAD with Zfinx and reuses P_LW_{ri,rr}_PostIncrement. The GPR result goes to users through getTargetExtractSubreg(sub_32, f32). This is the same thing as upstream's Zfinx pattern (f32 (bitconvert GPR)) -> (EXTRACT_SUBREG GPR, sub_32) at RISCVInstrInfoF.td:721 (llvmorg-20.1.8, checked). Upstream bc91f3cdd57c exists, is in llvmorg-19.1.7..llvmorg-20.1.8 and not in 19.1.7. Fork commits f1b7aebff8c2, c0c1019168f9 and c2f55316c07e exist with the cited subjects. The value, write-back and chain results are replaced correctly, then RemoveDeadNode. finalize-isel MIR shows '%16:gprf32 = COPY %15.sub_32' after each P_LW_ri_PostIncrement. After RA this is FMADD_S_INX on $x14_w/$x15_w with no extra instruction (disassembly: 2x p.lw + fmadd.s in a 3-insn lp.setup body vs 5 before). Why this differs from upstream's LW_INX-style GPRF32 opcode copy: PULPHardwareLoops.cpp:381-390 matches only the P_L*_PostIncrement opcodes as induction updates. Verified.
